I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message. I told him 25 November is the only date on record for the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal, and suggested he check it with Ilse before putting it in the account sheet.

- **Where the date comes from:** Ilse's message in #north-team on 14 Oct. Marcus is in that channel, so he can see it himself, and nobody has corrected or retracted it there since.
- **What I couldn't check:** none of the public files give a Brackenwater renewal date. The North cheat sheet only says the account is Great Lakes LTL freight and asked for a detention-log export. Marcus can't see any Brackenwater contract or account file, so I didn't look at those for him.
- **gbrain:** it refused the search again for the same reason, and nothing was read. Whoever runs that server still needs to fix it.

I didn't use `search_messages`.
